title: John Harbaugh: Cam Skattebo was not supposed to push on Jameis Winston sneak

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh: Cam Skattebo was not supposed to push on Jameis Winston sneak
sources.description: Giants coach John Harbaugh defended running back Cam Skattebo, who stayed in his stance on a crucial Jameis Winston quarterback sneak during Thursday night's loss to the Commanders.
